# Bruno Holanda

> FullStack Web Developer — React, Node.js, AWS. Portfolio, projects, and contact.

Site: https://www.brunoholanda.com
Language: Portuguese (primary), English available in UI

## About

Bruno Holanda is a FullStack Web Developer based in Brazil. He works at RPE (rpe.tech), Brazil's largest retail payment processor for store cards. Previously an administrative manager at Bradesco, he transitioned into tech and now ships production SAAS, freelance products, and educational content.

Stack day-to-day: React, React Native, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, AWS.
